# FORMWERK (21 · formwerk)

A Bauhaus poster machine — four rules, seeded compositions, downloadable SVG posters.

- **Technique:** GENERATIVE SVG
- **Tags:** bauhaus, generative, geometric, art, poster, primary colors, modernist
- **Best for:** design schools; art exhibitions; generative tools; studios
- **Fonts:** Archivo Black, Work Sans
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Work+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #efe9dc · #d5372c · #1d4f9e
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/formwerk/` (Template.astro, content.ts, meta.ts, poster.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`

## Signature effects
- `poster.ts`
  - `posterTitle(seed: number, titles: string[], numberSign: string)` — Caption shown under the poster for a seed, e.g. "AUSSTELLUNG №4".
  - `initPosterMachine(root: HTMLElement)` — Wire up the poster machine inside `root`: the big poster (#poster), its controls (#gen, #dl, #seedTxt, #titleTxt), the Space shortcut and the `.mini[data-seed]` strip. Configuration arrives as JSON in `root.dataset.config`.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br>/<span> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Which geometric glyph illustrates a rule. */
export type RuleShape = 'circle' | 'bar' | 'triangle' | 'type';

export interface Rule {
  shape: RuleShape;
  /** Text drawn for the `type` shape (e.g. "Aa"); ignored by other shapes. */
  glyph?: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark next to the three-shape mark, in nav and footer. */
  brand: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** The coloured full stops use `<span class="r|b|y">`. */
    headingHtml: string;
    subHtml: string;
  };
  /** The poster machine: copy for the controls and the inputs of the generator. */
  machine: {
    /** aria-label of the poster SVG. */
    posterLabel: string;
    newLabel: string;
    downloadLabel: string;
    /** Label before the live seed number. */
    seedLabel: string;
    /** Text before the keyboard-shortcut chip. */
    keyHintLabel: string;
    keyHintKey: string;
    /** Right-hand caption under the poster. */
    pressLabel: string;
    /** Seed shown on load. */
    initialSeed: number;
    /** Words one of which is set on each poster. */
    words: string[];
    /** Caption titles (a random one + number sign + 1–9 is shown under the poster). */
    titles: string[];
    /** Character placed before the 1–9 edition number in the caption. */
    numberSign: string;
    /** Metadata line printed on every poster: `${stampBefore}${seed padded to 4}${stampAfter}`. */
    stampBefore: string;
    stampAfter: string;
    /** Downloaded file name is `${downloadPrefix}-${seed padded to 4}.svg`. */
    downloadPrefix: string;
  };
  rules: {
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Rule[];
  };
  seeds: {
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Seeds rendered as clickable mini posters. */
    list: number[];
    /** Tooltip prefix for each mini poster: `${seedTitle} ${seed}`. */
    seedTitle: string;
    note: string;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered when the template's `showcase` prop is true. */
  showcase?: {
    chipLabel: string;
    chipHref: string;
    footerHtml: string;
  };
}
```

## Use it
- Full site: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs template formwerk --out <dir>`
- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style formwerk --out <dir>`
- Read `src/templates/formwerk/style.css` and `Template.astro` (from the plugin root) for exact component styling and markup.
